name: homeohub
description: HomeoHub monorepo: backend/ (Django + DRF) and frontend/ (Next.js).

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check . && .venv/bin/ruff format --check . && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && .venv/bin/mypy . && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
